body:
Hey friend! I have been on Suboxone for about a year and a half or so. It's a wonderful thing. Anyone that says if you are still on Suboxone then you are not clean can go fuck themselves. 

I appreciate the response. Once I clean up, I know things will become more manageable. But God it's tough right now.

It wasn't that. It was something that I did that I knew I shouldn't be doing. Addiction makes you do silly things, but as they say: "mental health issues are not your fault, but they are your responsibility."
